text:
Mara: Origami duel at the kitchen island in 10. Winner gets the last sushi and the Pen of Destiny. Rules: one sheet, 3 minutes. Judge: @Ash. Who's in? :crane:
Devin: I'm in. prepping my secret fold.
Samir: I'll fight for that sushi. full disclosure: my cranes look like sad hats.
Ash: Judge reporting in — I have a scorecard. Accepting bribes (coffee). :wink:
Benji: Can we livestream for posterity? I'll bring a tripod.
Priya: Team yellow supporting Samir. also camera's charged.
Mara: OK first round starts now. 3 minutes on the clock. go!
Devin: done. attached: a tiny ninja star (hand-crumpled).
Samir: finished. it resembles a barge but it's heartfelt.
Ash: Scoring... criteria: neatness, complexity, flight potential.
Ash: ```
neatness: 1-10
complexity: 1-10
flight: 1-5
total = neatness + complexity + flight
```
Ash: Scores — Devin 17 (8+8+1), Samir 13 (6+6+1). Winner: Devin. :tada:
StickerBot: :sticker: Devin earned 'Origami Duel Champion' sticker!
Priya: Petition to make this weekly. :raised_hands:
Benji: Can we institutionalize the Pen of Destiny? I nominate a rotating trophy (plastic stapler).
Mara: Done, plastic stapler is now the trophy. congrats @Devin! :sushi:
